Name: Dramallama's Clothing Mod
Author: 0Dramallama0
Description:
[center][/center][left][size=3]
[/size][/left][left][size=3]Hello! I hope you're having a great day :)

This is a mod that adds thirty-nine shirts and [/size]two skirts to the game using JSON assets. You will need that mod and content patcher to use this mod.

To access the clothes you need to also download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB item spawner[/url]﻿ mod. I put all of the names of the clothes around square brackets for organization, so you should be able to just put a single '[' square bracket into the search bar to get only this mod's clothes as a result. Anyways hope you enjoy them.
[/left]
